author: Spoookeh
body:
As I said in the title, this isn't just: There is a bug, please fix it.

I have probably told over 50 people in the space of 1 hour to "Please relog, you are invis." And honestly it is very annoying. I know the map devs and devs are probably working VERY hard to fix it as they have done to other glitches but I'm just putting it out there. This is a very annoying glitch and actually ruins the WHOLE game unlike other minor ones. You genuinely cannot just secure mid-points anymore because of invisible people sneaking up and you can never really defend properly. Please fix this ASAP.

Thank you for reading, Spookz__

replies.author: keenanjt
replies.body:
If you are seeing an invisible player, it's likely most others are seeing the player, so I'd suggest relogging yourself. It's based on the client receiving the correct packets, not invisible players sending bad packets. When I see someone saying another user is invisible, I have always been able to see the said player.

We're trying to address it, but it's difficult to diagnose when the cause is unknown and I have yet to experience the issue because, well, I have no idea.
